ratios.facility: Credit Facilities (Revolving Credit Facility and Term Loan Facility)
ratios.quote: As of September 30, 2026, our total leverage ratio was 2.61 :1.00.

parsed.notes: Limit is 3.75:1.00 for fiscal quarters ending before January 1, 2027, stepping down to 3.50:1.00 thereafter. Amendments dated October 7, 2026 (after period end) revise consolidated EBITDA to permit add-back of non-cash share-based compensation charges, which affects future ratio calculations.
